original.target_description: Experiment 1: test-phase 1D rule score, contingent-information versus full-information participants in the beekeeper task. Target identified by the supplied replication report claim summary. Original analysis is Bayesian parameter estimation rather than a frequentist t-test.

n.sample_role: Analytic participants: 48 contingent-information; 47 full-information. Group counts are printed separately; no summed total substituted.
n.exclusions: From 101 recruited, two used an external memory device and four required more than two attempts to pass a postinstructions quiz; excluded from further analyses (p. 1559, continuing at top of right column).

replication.target_description: Experiment 1 replication: contingent versus full-information conditions, test-phase 1D categorization accuracy scores; independent samples t-test. Focal target identified explicitly by the supplied replication report despite empty input locators.

n.sample_role: Participants in the analytic data set: 223 full-information, 251 contingent
n.exclusions: 100 of 574 completers excluded for reporting external memory aids.
n.quote: Of the 474 participants included in the analytic data set, 223 were in the full-information condition and 251 were in the contingent condition.

es.quote: The effect size was d = 0.4571, in the same direction as the original study.

reported_success.quote: We conclude that the result replicated according to SCORE criteria.

notes: Input study identifiers, neutral description, and both locators were empty. The supplied replication report explicitly selects the Experiment 1 test-phase 1D score contrast, enabling target identification independently of any dataset. Original paper title and DOI verified against its first page; replication title and project ID verified against its first page and the supplied ty5be OSF project file listing. The replication URL dnqrv is a file GUID, not a node. Original paper reports Bayesian mean-score comparison and 95% posterior credible interval [.03, .14], but no Cohen's d or p for this target; original es and p remain null. Group means and interval are not converted into d. The replication report separately prints a frequentist reanalysis of original data, t(93) = 2.91, p = 0.0045, 95% CI = 0.027 to 0.145 (p. 2); these are not substituted for the original paper's Bayesian analysis. Replication report p. 3 says the original excluded 1 person for external memory aids, whereas the original paper p. 1559 says two; the original n/exclusions record follows the original paper. No author-derived or extractor-derived effect metric conversion performed.
